_doc: Races offered at the level 3 choice. 'needs' are minimum dossier counts.

races.name: Stay as you are
races.text: No changes. Most crawlers keep their own body.

races.name: Gutterkin
races.text: Wiry tunnel folk. +2 Dexterity, -1 Constitution, +10% speed.

races.name: Glimmerling
races.text: Faintly luminous and very watchable. +3 Charisma, -2 Strength, +30% viewers.

races.name: Mossback
races.text: Slow, damp and hard to kill. +1 Intelligence, +1 Constitution, slow regeneration, -10% speed.

races.name: Rat-Blooded
races.text: Unlocked by killing ten things. The vermin have started to respect you. +1 Strength, +1 Dexterity, monsters notice you less.
